Polish Revolutionary Front.allies: You fight alongside the common citizenry and other Poles!
Polish Revolutionary Front.goal: Warsaw Command has sent you in to get a job done, and they have high hopes that you can help free Poland from Combine oppression - starting with City 13.
Polish Revolutionary Front.introduction: You are the Warsaw Resistance Agent!
Polish Revolutionary Front.uplink: Lambda scientists have provided the Polish Revolutionary Front with some uplinks; you have been provided one of them.

Lambda.allies: Other agents not from your Cell are to be distrusted, for they may not know the true value of your actions.
Lambda.goal: Bring freedom to the city at all costs.
Lambda.uplink: Lambda has provided you with a highly advanced uplink for the mission.

Black Market Agent.allies: Nobody is your true friend, unless they've got money.
Black Market Agent.goal: We're here to earn money, which includes doing what anyone else has paid for us to do.
Black Market Agent.introduction: You are the Black market agent.
Black Market Agent.roundend_report: was an agent of the Black Market.
Black Market Agent.uplink: You have purchased an uplink from Lambda for your mission.

Refugee Spy.allies: Lambda and other refugees may be willing to work with you, but no guarantees.
Refugee Spy.goal: You came here from the outlands and have a job to do, one that you believe must be done to ensure your survival back home.
Refugee Spy.uplink: You salvaged together an uplink from a fallen Lambda agent in the outlands.

Internal Affairs Agent.allies: Nobody is your ally here, keep quiet about your status.
Internal Affairs Agent.goal: You have been sent here by another district to complete a job. Make sure it gets done.
Internal Affairs Agent.introduction: You are the Internal Affairs Agent.
Internal Affairs Agent.roundend_report: was part of another District's Internal Affairs.
Internal Affairs Agent.uplink: For the sake of plausible deniability, you have been equipped with an array of captured Lambda weaponry available via uplink.

United Nations Remnant.allies: You work to unite the soldiers and civilians who still remember the name of peace!
United Nations Remnant.goal: You work to reform a peace long twisted by the Combine and bring it back to its original form, even if you are scarred fighting for it.
United Nations Remnant.introduction: You are the United Nations Remnant.
United Nations Remnant.uplink: After weeks of bartering on the Black Market, Lambda has granted you an uplink.

Radicalized.allies: You dream to work alongside a real rebel, but others who share your view would do just fine...
Radicalized.goal: Through the many propaganda posters or recent riots in your city, you have opened your previously blind eyes to the rebels fighting for freedom from the Combine. You are determined to help even if they do not know of you, and maybe even find a way to join through your efforts!
Radicalized.uplink: Through studying hidden messages in information campaign posters, you managed to piece together an uplink to connect with Lambda.

Contractor Support Unit.allies: You are being sent to help your designated agent. Their allegiences are above all others.
Contractor Support Unit.goal: Help your designated agent to the furtest extent you can, their life is above your own.
Contractor Support Unit.introduction: You are the Contractor Support Agent.
Contractor Support Unit.uplink: You do not come with your own uplink, defer to your agent.
